description: Plan an external task and get the exact call to run. Describe the job in plain words, not a vendor name: '4 product shots of this mug on marble', 'keyword volume for trail shoes in the US', 'work email for the CTO of acme.com'. Free: it runs and bills nothing. Returns mode='call': an ordered list of `use` calls, each with service, action, params, price_cents and max_cost_cents, and a short message on why this option and what the alternatives are (multi-step plans may hold placeholders like '<from step 1: sandbox_id>'; run earlier steps first and substitute). mode='converse': a question or options for the user; ask them and pass the answer back as the next intent (it remembers prior turns). mode='unsupported': not in the catalog. Replies carry 2-3 `suggestions`; offer the ones that fit. Optional: after running a plan, a one-line note on the outcome (what was produced, any failures) returns next steps that take the result into account. Check with consult before telling the user Vaaya can't do something.

intent.description: Plain-English description of what you want, or your answer to a previous clarify question. Be concrete — include the prompt text, URL, budget, or target the task implies.

name: consult

after_running.description: Reminder to call consult again with the outcome.

calls.description: Ordered list of { service, action, params, max_cost_cents, why } to run via `use`.

if_tools_missing.description: What to do when a named first-party tool (gtm_*, worker_*, …) is missing from your tool list: it was just unlocked — refresh the tool list; never improvise a fallback.

if_use_unavailable.description: What to do when the `use` tool is missing from your tool list — relay to the user.

message.description: Consultant's reply — relay to the user verbatim.

mode.description: How to proceed: relay 'converse', run 'call', or report 'unsupported'.

run_with.description: Which tool to execute the calls with.

suggestions.description: 2-3 suggested next steps to surface to the user.

title: Consult Vaaya — Plan Any Capability
